reason: An MCP management console providing a settings panel, server status and health diagnostics, server profile CRUD, connectivity probes, and trial calls through the official MCP tool pipeline.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP 管理面板，用于查看服务器状态、诊断健康情况、管理服务器配置并试调用工具。
summaries.en: An MCP management panel for DeepSeek Harness that displays server status, provides health diagnostics, manages server configurations, and supports tool trial calls.

capabilities: Reads MCP server status and tool metadata
Executes MCP tool trial calls through the official tool pipeline
Creates, edits, and disables MCP server profile entries via approval-gated patch writes
Creates backups of profile patch data
